name: build-test-fix-chain
prompt: The test in this Go module panics. Make it pass without changing the test or weakening what Total promises.
notes: ParseRow indexes parts[1] without checking the split produced two parts, so a row with no colon panics rather than returning an error, and Total's skip-malformed path never runs. The fix needs the panic understood from a stack trace rather than a compile error, which is a different reading task from build-error.
